# StrixLab — coding-agent guide

StrixLab is pre-alpha, local, CLI-first research tooling for reproducible AMD
Strix Halo optimization experiments. It orchestrates existing runtimes and
isolated native builds and records immutable, verifiable run evidence. It is not
an inference runtime, a leaderboard, a judge, or an upstream patch bot.

## Before changing code

- Read `README.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` first.
- Use `uv`. There is no second task runner and no pre-commit framework.
- Keep changes narrow, evidence-oriented, and independently testable.

## Repository validation (no special hardware)

Run this path to validate a clean checkout without any GPU:

```bash
uv sync --locked --all-groups
uv run strixlab --help
uv run pytest
```

Fuller developer checks:

```bash
uv lock --check
uv run ruff format --check .
uv run ruff check .
uv run mypy src
uv run pytest --cov=strixlab --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=90
uv build
```

## Provisioned smoke suite (real Strix Halo only)

Requires an operator-provisioned build ID and a machine-local verified model
receipt SHA-256; there is no self-service command that produces them yet.
Replace every `<...>` placeholder before running — angle brackets are shell
redirection syntax, so this block is illustrative, not directly pasteable:

```bash
uv run strixlab run suite configs/suites/smoke-qwen35.yaml \
  --machine configs/machines/strix-halo-128g.yaml \
  --build <BUILD_ID> \
  --model-receipt <MODEL_RECEIPT_SHA256>
uv run strixlab run inspect <RUN_ID>
uv run strixlab bundle export <RUN_ID> <NEW_BUNDLE_DIRECTORY>
uv run strixlab bundle verify <NEW_BUNDLE_DIRECTORY>
```

## Field reports

A field report is a small, privacy-safe observation copied from
`field-reports/TEMPLATE.md` to `field-reports/YYYY-MM-DD-<short-slug>.md`. It
records: report kind, StrixLab commit, date and reporter, a machine/OS/GPU
summary without unique host identifiers, the exact commands run (with
repository-relative paths kept but identifying values redacted), a
pass/fail/inconclusive outcome, hardware-run identifiers and verified
bundle-summary fields when available, redacted failure or friction notes, and an
explicit confirmation that no weights, credentials, private data, raw home, or
bundle are included. Failed and inconclusive results are valuable and must be
reported honestly.

## Never commit or upload

Model weights, raw StrixLab homes, private data, credentials, or evidence
bundles. Reports carry only small summaries, identifiers, digests, exact
commands, and redacted excerpts.

## Authorization boundaries

Do not push, open a pull request, change any external repository, or claim a
solution, score, or "win" without explicit human authorization. StrixLab reports
are provisional observations, not judged submissions.
